question: Who among the following was appointed as the first Municipal Commissioner of Bombay in 1865?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arthur Crawford.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Arthur Crawford **was appointed as the first Municipal Commissioner of Bombay in 1865.
 
• **Arthur Travers Crawford** was a British government employee.
 
• Crawford was famous as an able administrator as well as for his allegedly, underhand financial dealings.
 
• During the legal training of Arthur Crawford, he resolved to rebuild the municipality of Bombay and even put forward his proposal.
 
• He passed the **Municipal Corporation Act of 1872, **and since then he is known as the father of the Mumbai Municipal Corporation.
 
• In 1873, he became the municipal commissioner of the Bombay Municipal Corporation.
 
• He founded the Bombay Presidency Association in 1885. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Hunter Commission of 1882 was presided by **Sir William Hunter **and was appointed by Lord Ripon, the then Viceroy of India.
 
• **Charles Joseph Atkinson** is a British former boxer, fight promoter, manager, agent and trainer/coach.
 
• **Sir Ralph Howard Fowler OBE FRS** was a British physicist and astronomer.
